title: About Us | Winkelmann Group
content: Tel: +49 2382 856-0 | info@winkelmann-group.com. The Winkelmann Group, headquartered in Ahlen, Germany, is an internationally positioned group of companies for industrial solutions of high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems. In the 2024 financial year, we generated sales of about € 660 million. As a leader for industrial solutions of energy-efficient and high-performance systems and components - our core competence - we develop innovative products for renowned customers in the automotive, utility, and aerospace industries. We are particularly well known for our famous companies and business areas such as Winkelmann Automotive, reflexGroup, Winkelmann Flowforming, Winkelmann Construction Components and Winkelmann Erneuerbare Energien. Our Steel Services division complements our range of products and is a dependable service provider to steel processors. And our more than 4,000 employees worldwide are the reason for this. Together, we are continuing the tradition of the Winkelmann Group. **The Winkelmann Group in figures**. Boarding House of the Winkelmann Group. ## Contact the Winkelmann Group.

The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading companies in the field of metal forming. Automotive More than 100 years of know-how in metal forming technology with finesse in joining and painting, innovative potential in plastics technology and unconventional solutions in torsional vibration technology make up the business unit Automotive of the Winkelmann Group. Building + Industry Our products in the fields of heating, energy and plant engineering are state of the art thanks to our own research, development, cooperation with research institutes and production methods. Steel Services The Steel Services business unit has made a name for itself worldwide as an experienced and competent service provider in steel procurement and guarantees the disposition and just-in-time supply of flat steel products to the processing industry. Winkelmann Group is located in Ahlen, North Rhine-Westphalia, DE.

title: Company - WINKELMANN OEM Competence
content: As part of the Winkelmann Building+Industry business unit of the Winkelmann Group in Germany, the brand Winkelmann represents our OEM business with components and systems in buildings of all types and sizes as well as in a wide variety of industrial sectors and industries. **The Winkelmann Group is one of the leading group of companies in metal forming technology for well-known customers from a wide range of industry sectors and encompasses three business divisions: Automotive, Building+Industry and Flowforming.**. As a company anchored in tradition and managed by the fourth generation of the family, long-term thinking and working the principle of success with a high level of flexibility and innovative strength are key values for Winkelmann. The powerful Reflex brand, together with the brands Sinus, Nema and Winkelmann OEM, form the business unit Winkelmann Building+Industry, with an international team of over 2,100 employees and presence in more than 25 countries around the world.
